verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs describe an open-source toolkit for building AI applications on Postgres and pgvector, and the homepage lists 'Vector embeddings' as a core feature alongside the Postgres database. This covers storing embeddings and implies pgvector-based similarity search. missing for 10: explicit documentation of similarity-search queries/operators and vector indexing (e.g., HNSW/IVFFlat), and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search in practice.
